heard: Son of Gilead, of Micah's line Descending of Manasseh divine From Joseph's firstborn the branch grew Recorded in the genealogy Among the clans counted in Moab On the plains they stood in the tab Halak's name is written in stone Within the tribe he is known From Halak comes the Halakite clan Heart of man, I said, as the text has planned They receive their inheritance by lot In the land of Canaan, a sacred spot But she received Gilead and ocean
